method: Exact diff reconstruction and targeted static source inspection; PS5 syntax/builtin registry read-only check; no PHP source execution or full regression repeated here

read_only_parser_registry.observed_output: Builtin registry matches all 78 dispatcher names/aliases.

manual_hooks.finding: Outside HTML and PHP close-tag transitions complete before Read-PhpDocToken; successful doc token advances source offset and line then continues; ordinary regex is the final branch.
DOC uses char29 and its own dictionary; HTML uses char30 and its own dictionary. Both are non-name tokens; values are stored as data and are not reparsed as PHP source.
The selected FileMode or legacy call remains within literal compile-error try/catch. The compile return occurs before callback registration.
ValidateOnly queues warnings/validates escapes and skips interpolation evaluation. Runtime double_string branch evaluates expansion once per expression evaluation.
InitialIni and argument globals precede compile warning delivery; prelude setup follows; native callback is installed only afterwards.
One InvokeScalar site; one returned-output write branch; diagnostic events marked Delivered are not replayed.

Optional Set/Clear methods checked before callback install. Legacy contexts keep deferred events/handler rejection; original scalar unsupported prefix retained. Clear guarded by installation flag in finally.

Callee expression is evaluated once and initially validated before argument evaluation. Some array/callback paths revalidate the already-bound value through Invoke-PhpValueCallable; this does not re-run the callee expression or argument AST. Each selected dispatch branch evaluates arguments once and returns; no second invocation found.
Private Throwable cache/version and fallback save/restore preserved. Current prelude has no doc literals or HTML; its default lexer call does not enter FileMode.

known_limits_not_completion_claims: Read-only review is not proof of full PHP semantics, ABI completeness, or the fused candidate runtime results; root owns full965 and owner test loops.
Complex interpolation and arbitrary non-UTF8 PHP byte strings remain explicitly unsupported in the literal component.

Quote regex uses backslash-dot without Singleline. A backslash followed by newline is a potential pre-existing tokenization gap requiring separate oracle validation; same regex exists in113d, not an integration deletion.
Only selected native scalar/diagnostic callback profiles have prior execution evidence. General native values, lifecycle callbacks, arbitrary C++/async extensions, Linux and Web remain unverified.
Original PS-worker timeout/CLR exit observations remain unresolved. Separate normal outer-Main host results do not retroactively make those observations pass.
